## Workflow 1 — URL Discovery (v2)

Checks ChromaDB index status for all 7 exams and automatically re-indexes any that are empty or missing.

**Changes from v1:**
- Removed Build Exam List node (url_file/scraped_dir were dead code)
- Fixed 6× redundant API calls → now 1 GET
- Added EXPECTED_EXAMS list (catches exams missing from stats entirely)
- Added AI-901 to exam tracking
- Added auto-fix loop: gaps → POST /admin/index-documents per exam
- Added retry logic on HTTP node
- Set active: true

**Schedule:** Every Sunday at 01:00 AM
**Auto-fix:** Yes — re-indexes each failing exam sequentially
